lessons.title: Classify the task, then test the boundary
lessons.selection: The Concept Running Through the Book
lessons.ai_should: organize task records and propose alternative classifications
lessons.human_should: make the initial task decomposition, justify the boundary, and own the delegation decision

lessons.title: Measure when assistance helps
lessons.ai_should: suggest candidate rules and calculate comparisons
lessons.human_should: choose the test, justify each override, and interpret the bounded result

lessons.title: Keep the knowledge needed to check
lessons.selection: The baseline-knowledge condition: you cannot audit what you do not know
lessons.ai_should: explain syntax, give hints, and check calculations after the attempt
lessons.human_should: attempt the mechanism, explain the transfer case, and report actual learning

lessons.title: A description is not a physical measurement
lessons.selection: How embodied skill is actually taught
lessons.ai_should: draft a procedure and organize observations
lessons.human_should: perform or accurately label the observation task, notice feedback, and decide adjustments

lessons.title: Evaluate helpful language without inventing a relationship
lessons.selection: The performance is real; that is the trap
lessons.ai_should: draft alternative wording and flag unsupported claims
lessons.human_should: decide what is appropriate in context and avoid attributing feelings or commitments without evidence

lessons.title: Design a handoff to a real person
lessons.selection: How social intelligence is actually built — and how it is unbuilt
lessons.ai_should: prepare the handoff packet and identify missing information
lessons.human_should: conduct any real interaction, secure actual permission when needed, and own commitments

lessons.title: Check confidence against outcomes
lessons.selection: How metacognition is taught — and the transfer that never happens
lessons.ai_should: compute scores and propose error patterns
lessons.human_should: record original confidence, verify labels, and interpret uncertainty

lessons.title: Evaluate the checker
lessons.selection: Plausibility auditing: the named skill no curriculum teaches
lessons.human_should: choose the check, inspect support, and evaluate the evaluator

lessons.title: Separate prediction from an intervention
lessons.selection: Pearl's ladder, and the rung the machine lives on
lessons.ai_should: implement the supplied equations and compare outputs
lessons.human_should: state and defend the causal assumptions and scope

lessons.title: Ask what would change under a different action
lessons.selection: How the field teaches causation — and the error the teaching produces
lessons.ai_should: enumerate model consequences and design alternatives
lessons.human_should: choose defensible assumptions and distinguish proposed studies from evidence

lessons.title: Compare many judgments with one repeated judgment
lessons.selection: What makes a group smart — and the friction the machine throws away
lessons.human_should: specify dependence assumptions and judge relevance to the actual team

lessons.title: Preserve disagreement before summarizing
lessons.selection: What the machine compresses, and what it cannot
lessons.ai_should: organize positions and propose a traceable summary
lessons.human_should: contribute an independent view, deliberate with actual peers when available, and resolve or preserve disagreement

lessons.title: An efficient answer still needs an end worth choosing
lessons.selection: Wisdom is not the top of the knowledge hierarchy
lessons.ai_should: calculate scenarios and articulate alternative considerations
lessons.human_should: justify the objective, consider affected interests, and own the bounded recommendation

lessons.title: Exposure is a measurement claim
lessons.selection: Deprioritization is not deletion — at full stakes
lessons.ai_should: compute and compare clearly labeled hypothetical indices
lessons.human_should: justify the construct, inspect coverage, and avoid claiming unratified research findings

lessons.title: Build and defend the division of labor
lessons.ai_should: draft, compute, implement, and challenge the candidate
lessons.human_should: practice the mechanism, verify the evidence, maintain actual relationships, and own the final handoff
